title: Create and ingest data into a Vector Store

cues.en: Now that we have our understanding of vectors and what we are going to put into a vector store, let's build the vector store and ingest some data.
cues.zh: 現在已經理解向量，以及要放進向量儲存區的資料，接下來建立儲存區並匯入資料。

cues.en: And in order to do that, I've made up a few dummy samples of some kind of internal handbook or knowledge base at a
cues.zh: 為此，我編了幾個假資料，模擬公司內部手冊或知識庫的

cues.en: company.
cues.zh: 內容。

cues.en: And one of the questions is our previous question about what is the office password.
cues.zh: 其中一個問題，就是先前的辦公室 Wi-Fi 密碼。

cues.en: But there's other things like is Christmas Eve a holiday, how to register for vacation and such a thing.
cues.zh: 另外還有平安夜是否放假、如何申請休假等問題，

cues.en: Doesn't really matter.
cues.zh: 實際內容不是重點。

cues.en: And this is just 10.
cues.zh: 這裡只有十筆，

cues.en: That would be several hundred in a normal company probably.
cues.zh: 一般公司可能會有好幾百筆。

cues.en: But we have this data, and we're going to make a normal connection as before.
cues.zh: 準備好資料後，一樣建立連線，

cues.en: And we're going to make the vector generator.
cues.zh: 再建立向量產生器，

cues.en: And then we're going to choose our vector store.
cues.zh: 接著選擇向量儲存區。

cues.en: So there's various options, but I have chosen in this case a SQLite because it is easy to work with, although a bit limited.
cues.zh: 有很多選項，這裡選 SQLite，因為容易使用，雖然功能有些限制。

cues.en: There is certain that have just taken on the job and say, hey, I also want to be a vector store.
cues.zh: 有些系統原本不是專門做向量搜尋，後來才加入這項能力。

cues.en: SQLite was officially just a SQL.
cues.zh: SQLite 最初就是一般的 SQL 資料庫，

cues.en: While others have been dedicated from day one to being a vector store.
cues.zh: 另一些產品則從第一天就專門設計為向量儲存區。

cues.en: So there's different options.
cues.zh: 所以有不同選擇。

cues.en: And up here, we can see Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB, Elasticsearch in memory, and all kinds of different vector stores.
cues.zh: 上面可以看到 Azure AI Search、Cosmos DB、Elasticsearch、記憶體內儲存，以及其他各種向量儲存區。

cues.en: I will show a few examples down here of the ones I have tried.
cues.zh: 下面也會展示幾個我試過的例子。

cues.en: But we need a new NuGet package in order to do this.
cues.zh: 使用它們需要新的 NuGet 套件，

cues.en: So I have put in one more NuGet package.
cues.zh: 所以這裡又加入了一個套件，

cues.en: That NuGet package is Microsoft Semantic Kernel Connectors SQLite Vector Store.
cues.zh: 名叫 Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.SqliteVec。

cues.en: So this is part of something called Microsoft Extensions.VectorData. It just has a little funny name because this is actually the old version
cues.zh: 它屬於 Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData 這套架構。名稱有點奇怪，因為仍保留 Agent Framework 前身的

cues.en: of Agent Framework, but it's only by name.
cues.zh: 名稱，但只是名稱如此，

cues.en: It has nothing to do with the old stuff.
cues.zh: 和舊版框架的其他部分沒有關係。

cues.en: But this is our implementation, and they have other connectors to the other vector stores.
cues.zh: 這是我們使用的實作，也有連接其他向量儲存區的連接器。

cues.en: So what we're going to do is we're going to make a connection string to a SQLite.
cues.zh: 首先，建立 SQLite 的連線字串，

cues.en: So that's just writing data source and then a path to some place.
cues.zh: 也就是寫 Data Source，再指定某個路徑。

cues.en: In my case, I'm putting it down in my temp folder.
cues.zh: 我放在暫存資料夾裡。

cues.en: And then I'm going to new up a vector store.
cues.zh: 然後建立新的 VectorStore，

cues.en: In this case, it's Microsoft Semantic Kernel Connectors Vector Store SQLite.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors 底下的 SQLite 實作。

cues.en: And I'm putting in the connection string, and then I'm making a vector store options object, which I give the generator.
cues.zh: 傳入連線字串，再建立 VectorStoreOptions，並提供嵌入產生器。

cues.en: So we're hooking this up to this because then it can generate on its own.
cues.zh: 把兩者連接起來後，儲存區就能自己產生向量。

cues.en: We could technically sit down and take any kind of thing that can support vectors and begin to generate the vectors ourselves and put
cues.zh: 技術上也能選任何支援向量的儲存系統，自己產生向量，然後

cues.en: them in using the SQL language or the language of the vector store.
cues.zh: 透過 SQL 或該儲存區的語言寫入。

cues.en: But this is just a convenient way to not do that.
cues.zh: 但這個抽象層，讓我們不必自己處理。

cues.en: So we have this vector store now.
cues.zh: 現在已經建立好向量儲存區，

cues.en: We could have made others.
cues.zh: 當然也可以建立其他類型。

cues.en: So, for example, if we wanted to have Azure AI Search, which is a powerful but quite expensive version of a vector store.
cues.zh: 例如 Azure AI Search，功能強大，但價格也相對高。

cues.en: And in that, we would just need to give our endpoint and our key in order to do this.
cues.zh: 使用時，提供端點和金鑰即可。

cues.en: If we wanted to use SQL Server, it works from SQL Server 2025 and forward.
cues.zh: 如果使用 SQL Server，則需要 SQL Server 2025 或之後的版本，

cues.en: We would just need a connection string.
cues.zh: 提供連線字串就可以了。

cues.en: And if we wanted to use Cosmos DB, who can also do it, we would need a connection string, the database name, and tell a little about serialisation.
cues.zh: Cosmos DB 也支援，需要連線字串、資料庫名稱，再設定一些序列化資訊。

cues.en: So all of them is just about some connection string to get something up and running, but they all turn out to be a vector store.
cues.zh: 所以基本上都是透過連線資訊啟動，最後都會得到 VectorStore。

cues.en: So we are having a general system.
cues.zh: 這是一套通用的介面。

cues.en: And then we are going to make what is called a collection.
cues.zh: 接著建立所謂的 Collection，

cues.en: So we're getting a collection.
cues.zh: 也就是取得集合，

cues.en: We are telling that the primary key is GWT.
cues.zh: 指定主索引鍵的型別是 Guid，

cues.en: And our data is equal to this object we have here.
cues.zh: 資料型別則是下面這個物件。

cues.en: I didn't mention this one up here was just a question and an answer.
cues.zh: 剛才上面的原始資料，只有問題和答案，

cues.en: But this down here is a bit more in that we are going to tell that we have an object that should represent a record in our vector store.
cues.zh: 但下面這個類別更完整，用來表示向量儲存區裡的一筆記錄。

cues.en: In a SQL, it's a table.
cues.zh: 在 SQL 裡，它會對應一張資料表，

cues.en: But in Azure AI Search, it's an index.
cues.zh: 在 Azure AI Search 裡，則對應一個索引。

cues.en: So it's called collection just to be more generic.
cues.zh: 所以為了通用，統一稱為 Collection。

cues.en: But in a SQL Server, it's just a table.
cues.zh: 但在 SQL Server 裡，實際上就是資料表。

cues.en: And then we're going to tell we have an ID, which is the key of this.
cues.zh: 接著指定 ID，這是這筆資料的鍵值，

cues.en: And then we can put in one or more pieces of data, because we haven't really talked about this yet.
cues.zh: 也能放一個或多個資料欄位。這部分前面還沒特別說明，

cues.en: But whenever we do a vector similarity search, once we have found the right search, we actually need the real data to give back to the LLM.
cues.zh: 向量相似度搜尋找到結果後，仍然需要把真正的原始資料交給 LLM。

cues.en: It doesn't really want to have the vector.
cues.zh: LLM 並不想要向量本身，

cues.en: It just want to have the data that was similar to it in its original form.
cues.zh: 它需要的是那份相似資料的原始內容。

cues.en: So we're saving the question and the answer.
cues.zh: 所以要保存問題和答案，

cues.en: And we are putting in vector store data here.
cues.zh: 並在這裡標記 VectorStoreData。

cues.en: And if you have a lot of data, you can put in to make it indexes and give it new names if need be.
cues.zh: 如果資料很多，也能設定索引，或依需要指定不同欄位名稱。

cues.en: The final one we need to have is a vector store vector.
cues.zh: 最後，還需要一個 VectorStoreVector 欄位，

cues.en: So the vector we have, how many dimensions it is, and what should represent the vector.
cues.zh: 指定向量有多少維度，以及哪一份內容代表向量資料。

cues.en: In our case, we want to have that the question and the answer is the vector.
cues.zh: 這裡希望把問題和答案一起轉成向量，

cues.en: So we get it in Q, question dash A, answer.
cues.zh: 因此組合為 Q、問題，再接 A、答案，

cues.en: That would be what we want to embed.
cues.zh: 這就是要做 Embedding 的內容。

cues.en: So when we do that, we get this back, and we can give it a name.
cues.zh: 設定好後，取得集合，並給它一個名稱。

cues.en: So in our case, since it's a SQL, it will be the table name.
cues.zh: 因為這裡是 SQL，這會是資料表名稱；

cues.en: In an Azure AI search, it would be the index name.
cues.zh: 如果是 Azure AI Search，就是索引名稱。

cues.en: So once we have one of these, we can call a method called ensure collection exists, meaning a creation of it.
cues.zh: 取得集合後，呼叫 EnsureCollectionExists，確保集合已建立。

cues.en: So in, again, a SQL, it will be create table.
cues.zh: 對 SQL 來說，就是 CREATE TABLE；

cues.en: And in an Azure AI search, it will be create index.
cues.zh: 對 Azure AI Search 來說，就是建立索引。

cues.en: So now we have it, our table, and we can ask if we want to import data.
cues.zh: 現在資料表有了，接著詢問是否要匯入資料。

cues.en: So I just put it in so we don't need to import every single time.
cues.zh: 我加上這個詢問，避免每次執行都重新匯入。

cues.en: But if we run it the first time here, we can see it comes and asks
cues.zh: 第一次執行時，可以看到它會詢問，

cues.en: us, do we want to import data?
cues.zh: 是否要匯入資料。

cues.en: And just so it's easy here, normally you would do a little more data manipulation.
cues.zh: 為了讓範例簡單，這裡先用簡化的做法；實務上通常還會做更多資料處理，

cues.en: I will talk a little about that in one second.
cues.zh: 等等再補充。

cues.en: But in this case, just to ensure that we get rid of all the old data, I just say we actually delete the table again and recreate it.
cues.zh: 這裡為了清除全部舊資料，我直接刪除資料表，再重新建立。

cues.en: Then we are sure that it's empty.
cues.zh: 如此就能確定裡面是空的。

cues.en: We can actually go in and work with the data, delete certain things.
cues.zh: 其實也能逐筆操作資料，刪除指定記錄。

cues.en: But my main problem, if I just added new data all the time, is that right now my ID is a new grid every single time.
cues.zh: 但目前的問題是，每次匯入，我都會產生新的 Guid 作為 ID。

cues.en: Had it been something that were fixed for my records, I could just run this again and again and absurd it, meaning if it
cues.zh: 如果每筆記錄有固定的 ID，就能反覆執行 Upsert，也就是當資料

cues.en: already exists, it would update it instead.
cues.zh: 已存在時，改成更新。

cues.en: So I'm going to delete and create.
cues.zh: 所以這裡先採用刪除再建立。

cues.en: And then we are going to go to our 10 knowledge bases.
cues.zh: 接著逐一處理十筆知識庫資料，

cues.en: And we are just going to say absurd async with this new record that we want.
cues.zh: 把要保存的新記錄傳入 UpsertAsync。

cues.en: So we just give it the ID, the question, and the answer.
cues.zh: 只要提供 ID、問題和答案。

cues.en: And behind the scenes, absurd will go in and do our embedding, like we saw in the previous lecture.
cues.zh: 底層的 Upsert 會替我們產生 Embedding，就像上一堂看過的流程。

cues.en: We can actually send the embeddings in to absurd if we want to.
cues.zh: 如果願意，也能自行產生向量，再交給 Upsert，

cues.en: But this is just an easier way.
cues.zh: 但這個做法比較方便。

cues.en: So it will take a little time, because every time we run this, we go up into Azure and do our embedding.
cues.zh: 會花一點時間，因為每次都必須連到 Azure 產生嵌入向量。

cues.en: But if we run it, we now have our 10 embeddings in.
cues.zh: 執行完成後，十筆向量資料就已經匯入。

cues.en: And what I do down here, let's try and rerun it so we can see what this is about.
cues.zh: 下面這段；重新執行一次，就能看出它的用途。

cues.en: Let's just say no.
cues.zh: 這次回答 No。

cues.en: We can also list our data.
cues.zh: 也可以列出儲存的資料。

cues.en: So there is a get async.
cues.zh: 這裡有 GetAsync 方法。

cues.en: It's not like we can write SQL against it, because again, this is a generic setup against indexes, SQLs, all kinds of ways of
cues.zh: 不能直接對這套介面寫 SQL，因為它是通用抽象，同時支援索引、SQL，以及各種

cues.en: implementing a vector store.
cues.zh: 向量儲存區的實作。

cues.en: So we need to do a get async where we do a small func record.
cues.zh: 所以使用 GetAsync，搭配一個針對記錄的條件函式。

cues.en: And in our case, I'm just saying give me all records that doesn't have the empty GWT, meaning all of them.
cues.zh: 這裡只說：傳回所有 ID 不等於空 Guid 的記錄，也就是全部資料。

cues.en: And here I'm setting how many records do I want back.
cues.zh: 再設定要取回多少筆，

cues.en: I want as many as possible.
cues.zh: 這裡希望盡可能全部取得。

cues.en: And doing that, I will get my first record back.
cues.zh: 如此就會取得第一筆記錄，

cues.en: So the first record here is our question about Wi-Fi.
cues.zh: 第一筆是 Wi-Fi 的問題，

cues.en: Print it out.
cues.zh: 把它輸出，

cues.en: Next.
cues.zh: 接著下一筆。

cues.en: So we're just doing a for each on all the data.
cues.zh: 所以只是對全部資料做 foreach。

cues.en: Behind the scenes, this implementation will use a SQL in order to get this information, while an Azure AI search will use their API
cues.zh: 底層的 SQLite 實作會使用 SQL 取得資料；Azure AI Search 則會透過自己的 API，

cues.en: to get the data instead.
cues.zh: 讀取資料。

cues.en: So we just get our 10 questions out here just for us to see that they are in there.
cues.zh: 這裡列出十個問題，只是確認資料確實已經存入。

cues.en: We could also go to the SQLite database, but it has a slight odd way of
cues.zh: 也能直接打開 SQLite 資料庫，但它保存向量的方式有點特別，

cues.en: storing the vectors, which again is abstracted away from us.
cues.zh: 不過這些細節都已經被抽象層隱藏。

cues.en: In SQL, it's just a column, but in SQLite, it's some more extra tables that have the data for some reason that they have
cues.zh: 在 SQL Server 中，向量就是一個欄位；SQLite 則基於它的實作方式，額外用一些資料表

cues.en: chosen.
cues.zh: 保存資料。

cues.en: It doesn't really matter to us.
cues.zh: 對我們來說，這不是重點。

cues.en: We now have our vector store.
cues.zh: 現在向量儲存區已經準備好了，

cues.en: So with our data put in, so now we should be able to actually finish this and begin to search against it as well.
cues.zh: 資料也已匯入，接下來就能把流程完成，開始對它進行搜尋。
